library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)

# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

R2_A0 <- haven::read_sas("data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_sc_02_rdb_02.sas7bdat")

```

## Corriger données d'identité

```{r}

# Ajouter id_doublon
R2_A1 <- R2_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
    select(-c(id_date_creation:ps_interromp), -c(sc_type:sc_rdb_cat), -rdb_type) %>% 
    rename(
        "sc_rdb_an" = "rd_an",
        "sc_rdb_cause" = "rd_cause",
        "sc_rdb_classe" = "rd_classe",
        "sc_rdb_classe_autre" = "rd_classe_autre",
        "add_sc_rdb_classe_cat" = "rd_classe_cat"
    ) %>% 
        relocate(
            c("ps_redoubl", "rdb_ps_redoubl", "sc_rdb_classe", "sc_rdb_classe_autre",
            "add_sc_rdb_classe_cat", "sc_rdb_an", "sc_rdb_cause"), .after = rdb_date_creation
        )



```
